objective.text: The investigation set out to characterize the behavior of weak coflow diffusion flames of methane and ethylene, as a function of velocity and fuel dilution.
objective.quote: Characterize the behavior of weak coflow diffusion flames of methane and ethylene, as a function of velocity and fuel dilution, through measurement of flame shape, lift-off heights, temperatures and extinction limits.

fuel.text: The fuels burned in the diffusion flames were methane and ethylene.
fuel.quote: Characterize the behavior of weak coflow diffusion flames of methane and ethylene, as a function of velocity and fuel dilution, through measurement of flame shape, lift-off heights, temperatures and extinction limits.

variables.text: The variables between tests included velocity and fuel dilution.

measurements.text: Measurements included flame shape, lift-off heights, temperatures, and extinction limits.
measurements.quote: Characterize the behavior of weak coflow diffusion flames of methane and ethylene, as a function of velocity and fuel dilution, through measurement of flame shape, lift-off heights, temperatures and extinction limits.

earth_benefits.text: An understanding of those factors that affect flame extinction in diffusion flames is critical in the suppression of fires and in improving engine efficiency.
